lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: God
lines.text:
Every world has its own rhythm.
Learn it, and you’ll be understood by all things.

lines.speaker: player
lines.name: Cat
options: Then tell me how this world listens.
Never heard of it... but I'll try.
If I have to do it this way, then fine.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: God
lines.text:
Don’t worry about mistakes.
Even light had to break through darkness first.

lines.speaker: player
lines.name: Cat
options: Let’s see where this rhythm takes me.
I’ll follow the beat, not the rules.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: God
lines.text: Then let your heart answer with the rhythm.
